title: Why Your Stomach Growls Even When You're Full

title: Humans Are Closer to T-Rex Than T-Rex Was to Stegosaurus

title: Early Earth's Days Lasted Only Six Hours

title: Lightning Burns Hotter Than the Sun's Surface

title: Mirrors Never Actually Flip Left and Right

title: Earth Was a Giant Snowball for 300 Million Years
claim: Earth was almost entirely frozen over for roughly 300 million years during the Cryogenian period.

title: Skyscrapers Are Built to Sway in the Wind on Purpose
claim: Tall skyscrapers are engineered to sway several feet in high wind so they don't snap.

title: Shattered Glass Always Cracks Into Curves, Never Straight Lines
claim: Cracked glass splits along curved lines because the fracture can't outrun its own stress wave.

title: No Astronaut Has Ever Truly Run on the Moon
claim: Lunar gravity is so weak that normal running is physically impossible, forcing astronauts into a bounding gait.

title: Coal Exists Because Nothing Could Decompose Trees Yet

title: Astronauts' Blood Rushes Upward in Zero Gravity
claim: In microgravity, blood shifts toward astronauts' heads instead of pooling in their legs.

title: Space Probes Steal Speed From Planets to Travel Farther

title: Astronomers Found a Planet Made Mostly of Diamond

title: A Spacecraft Could Sail Across Space on Pure Sunlight
claim: Solar sail spacecraft accelerate using only the pressure of sunlight, with no fuel required.

title: A Starship Launched Today Would Land With Your Descendants Aboard
claim: Reaching the nearest star system with current technology would take so long only descendants of the crew would arrive.

title: One Star Hosts Seven Earth-Sized Planets at Once
claim: The TRAPPIST-1 system contains seven roughly Earth-sized planets orbiting a single small star.

title: Rogue Planets Wander the Galaxy With No Star at All
claim: Thousands of rogue planets drift through the Milky Way untethered to any star.
